brief.summary_1line: Kumbhakarna rejects deceit, vows to kill Rama, is armed and honored by Ravana, marches with a vast host despite ominous portents, terrifying the monkey army.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana crowns the colossal Kumbhakarna with a pearl-studded diadem and golden ornaments before sending him to battle.
The gigantic Kumbhakarna strides out of Lanka with a blazing spear while armies of strange mounts and warriors thunder behind him.
As Kumbhakarna advances, dark clouds, meteors, and howling jackals appear while a vulture lands ominously on his spear.
